game.title: New York Giants at Los Angeles Rams

lede: Los Angeles Rams carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#1 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Los Angeles Rams -8.8 with a fair total of 49.8, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Los Angeles Rams run offence vs New York Giants run defence, which sits +0.156 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
